name: threenative

scripts.budgets: tsx scripts/workspace-packages.ts && tsx scripts/check-version-pins.ts && tsx scripts/check-native-shims.ts && tsx scripts/check-core-boundary.ts && tsx scripts/check-template-conventions.ts && tsx scripts/check-capability-docs.ts --census && pnpm caps:recall && tsx scripts/check-evidence-budget.ts && tsx scripts/vfx-niagara-coverage.ts && tsx scripts/check-budgets.ts && tsx scripts/generate-ctx-surface-table.ts --check && tsx scripts/generate-capability-reference.ts --check && tsx scripts/realism-effects-docs.ts --check && tsx scripts/realism-effects-conformance.ts && tsx scripts/realism-effects-matrix.ts && tsx scripts/detect-capability-duplicates.ts examples --strict && tsx scripts/check-template-quality.ts && tsx scripts/sync-mcp-configs.ts --check
scripts.build: tsx scripts/build-capability-manifest.ts && tsx scripts/generate-ctx-surface-table.ts && tsx scripts/generate-capability-reference.ts && tsx scripts/realism-effects-docs.ts && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.capabilities:sync: tsx scripts/build-capability-manifest.ts && tsx scripts/generate-ctx-surface-table.ts && tsx scripts/generate-capability-reference.ts
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --filter @threenative/playtest build && sh scripts/xvfb.sh playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:ci: test -f packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js || { echo 'TN_PREBUILT_PLAYWRIGHT_RUNNER_MISSING: packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js' >&2; exit 1; }; command -v playwright >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'TN_PREBUILT_PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_MISSING: playwright is not installed' >&2; exit 1; }; test -n "${THREENATIVE_PACKED_PACKAGES:-}" && test -d "$THREENATIVE_PACKED_PACKAGES" && test -s "$THREENATIVE_PACKED_PACKAGES/specs" || { echo 'TN_PREBUILT_WORKSPACE_ARCHIVE_MISSING: THREENATIVE_PACKED_PACKAGES must point to a verified archive directory' >&2; exit 1; }; test -n "$(find "$THREENATIVE_PACKED_PACKAGES" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.tgz' -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" || { echo 'TN_PREBUILT_WORKSPACE_ARCHIVE_MISSING: no workspace archive was found' >&2; exit 1; }; sh scripts/xvfb.sh playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:playtest: pnpm --filter @threenative/playtest build && sh scripts/xvfb.sh node packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtest/moves.json --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtest/camera.json --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtests/movement-axis.playtest.json --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtests/zoom-input.playtest.json --url http://127.0.0.1:5180 --server-command 'pnpm --filter abyss-framework dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort' --browser-recipe webgpu --headed && sh scripts/xvfb.sh node packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtests/navigation.playtest.json --url 'http://127.0.0.1:5180/?navigation' --server-command 'pnpm --filter abyss-framework dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort' --browser-recipe webgpu --headed && sh scripts/xvfb.sh node packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtests/streaming.playtest.json --url 'http://127.0.0.1:5180/?streaming' --server-command 'pnpm --filter abyss-framework dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort' --browser-recipe webgpu --headed
scripts.test:playtest:ci: test -f packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js || { echo 'TN_PREBUILT_PLAYWRIGHT_RUNNER_MISSING: packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js' >&2; exit 1; }; sh scripts/xvfb.sh node packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtest/moves.json --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtest/camera.json --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtests/movement-axis.playtest.json --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtests/zoom-input.playtest.json --url http://127.0.0.1:5180 --server-command 'pnpm --filter abyss-framework dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort' --browser-recipe webgpu --headed --allow-software && sh scripts/xvfb.sh node packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js --scenario examples/abyss-framework/playtests/navigation.playtest.json --url 'http://127.0.0.1:5180/?navigation' --server-command 'pnpm --filter abyss-framework dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort' --browser-recipe webgpu --headed --allow-software
scripts.test:templates: sh scripts/xvfb.sh tsx scripts/verify-template-playtests.ts && pnpm test:tone
scripts.test:vfx-gallery: pnpm --filter @threenative/playtest build && pnpm --filter @threenative/core build && pnpm --filter vfx-gallery build && tsx scripts/vfx-gallery-visual.ts

description: ThreeNative is an application framework for games whose same vanilla Three.js source runs in the browser on WebGPU and on an owned C++ runtime for desktop and Android. It uses Godot-shaped node names, React and Tailwind for UI, and vanilla `three` underneath on every surface.
